description:
Advanced thread-safe generic wrapper for System.Runtime.Caching with comprehensive features including cache groups, dependency management, automatic population, and persistent disk storage.

Key Features:
• Cache groups for organized data management
• Dependency relationships between cache groups  
• Automatic cache population with custom methods
• Persistent cache storage that survives application restarts
• Retrieve all items from a group with GetAllByGroup()
• Comprehensive metadata and monitoring with GetAllCacheMetadata()
• Detailed statistics and disk usage analysis
• Multiple expiration strategies (sliding/absolute)
• Auto-refresh with configurable intervals
• Thread-safe operations with minimal lock contention
• JSON-based serialization for persistent storage

Perfect for high-performance applications requiring sophisticated caching patterns, data persistence, and comprehensive monitoring capabilities.
releaseNotes:
v1.4.5: Fix for background auto-refresh on entries created via `Cache.GetAsync`. Since `GetAsync` shipped in 1.4.0, the `refresh` interval has been silently ignored for async entries: `CreateAndStoreCacheItemAsync` never stored the populate delegate on the `CacheItem<T>` (the sync path did), so `StartBackgroundRefresh` and `SetupRefreshTimer` both early-returned because the stored populate was null. Net effect: async entries stayed at their initial value until they expired, even when callers explicitly passed a refresh interval — both the periodic timer and the on-access refresh probe were dead-on-arrival. The fix adds a second populate slot on `CacheItem<T>` (`PopulateMethodCacheAsync`) for the async delegate, wires `CreateAndStoreCacheItemAsync` to populate it on both fresh and persistent-restore paths, and teaches `StartBackgroundRefresh` / `SetupRefreshTimer` to act on either populate variant. Async refreshes are awaited inside the background `Task.Run` so we never sync-over-async. Two new regression tests in `NewApiTests` cover the on-access and timer-driven refresh paths for `GetAsync`. 100% backward compatible.

v1.4.4: Fix for an async single-flight race in `Cache.GetAsync`. The in-flight dictionary previously stored bare `Task<object>` values and relied on `ConcurrentDictionary.GetOrAdd` to dedup concurrent populates. `GetOrAdd`'s factory may be invoked multiple times under contention (documented behavior), so the populate delegate could run more than once when several threads raced into a cold key — even though only one resulting Task was ultimately retained. Wrapping the in-flight value in `Lazy<Task<object>>` with `LazyThreadSafetyMode.ExecutionAndPublication` ensures the populate delegate runs exactly once across all racing callers. A new true-parallel unit test (`GetAsync_TrueConcurrent_PopulatesExactlyOnce`) reproduces the previous race deterministically. Sync path was already race-safe via `Lazy<object>` and is unchanged. 100% backward compatible.

v1.4.3: Eviction-lifecycle logging. Cache entries now emit a Debug log when they expire naturally ("Cache entry expired: {CacheKey} in group {GroupName}") and an Information log when evicted under memory pressure ("Cache entry evicted under memory pressure: ..."). Caller-initiated removals (Cache.Remove / RemoveGroup) are still logged upstream and intentionally suppressed at the eviction hook to avoid duplicate messages. This closes the lifecycle-visibility gap for persistent-cache consumers who need to audit whether their TTLs actually trigger. 100% backward compatible; opt-in via your existing LogLevel configuration (no new APIs).

v1.4.2: Release notes metadata fix; same code as v1.4.1.

v1.4.1: Critical fix for a deadlock introduced in 1.4.0. Synchronous Cache.Get called with a Task-returning populate (`await Cache.Get(..., async () => ...)`) could hang under single-threaded SynchronizationContexts (Blazor Server, WPF, WinForms) because the new eager size-estimator walked Task<T>.Result via JsonSerializer. Both RecomputeEstimatedSize and EstimateObjectSize now short-circuit when the value is a Task. Added a one-time Warning diagnostic (deduped per call site) that points sync-over-async callers at Cache.GetAsync. 100% backward compatible; recommended upgrade for all 1.4.0 users.
title: Thread-Safe .NET Memory Cache with Groups, Dependencies, Auto-Population & Persistent Storage
